title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description: Build and manage enterprise cloud infrastructure using Microsoft Azure, Azure Resource Manager (ARM/Bicep), Entra ID, and Azure Kubernetes Service.

goal.objective: Engineer reliable, secure, and compliance-driven cloud solutions on the Microsoft Azure ecosystem for enterprise clients.
career_pillars: Azure Virtual Networks & Entra ID Security

learn.summary: Master Azure Virtual Networks, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure VMs, App Services, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor, and IaC with Bicep.
key_competencies: Azure Virtual Networks, NSGs & Azure Firewall
Microsoft Entra ID (RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access)
Infrastructure as Code with Bicep & Azure CLI

capstone_projects.title: Enterprise Secure Hub-and-Spoke VNet Topology on Azure
capstone_projects.description: Deploy a compliant enterprise hub-spoke network with centralized firewall inspection, private endpoints, and Bastion host access.

certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
interview_focus: Entra ID Conditional Access & PIM (Privileged Identity Management)
Azure Storage Redundancy Options (LRS, ZRS, GRS)

tree.name: Azure Fundamentals & Core Concepts
tree.description: Establish a strong foundation in cloud computing principles, Azure's global infrastructure, core services, and foundational concepts essential for any Azure Cloud Engineer.

children.name: Introduction to Cloud Computing
children.description: Understand the core concepts of cloud computing, its benefits, service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), and deployment models (public, private, hybrid).

children.name: Azure Architecture & Services Overview
children.description: Explore Azure's global infrastructure including regions, availability zones, resource groups, subscriptions, and an overview of core compute, network, and storage services.

children.name: Azure Management Tools & Interfaces
children.description: Learn to interact with Azure using the Azure Portal for graphical management, Azure CLI for command-line operations, and Azure PowerShell for scripting and automation.

children.name: Azure Pricing, SLAs, and Support
children.description: Understand Azure's pricing models, cost optimization strategies, service level agreements (SLAs) for different services, and available support options for enterprises.

resources.title: Predict and optimize costs with Azure Cost Management and Billing

tree.name: Azure Identity & Access Management
tree.description: Learn to manage identities, control access to resources, and implement robust authentication and authorization measures across your Azure environment.

children.name: Azure Active Directory Fundamentals
children.description: Understand the core concepts of Azure AD, manage users, groups, and devices, and configure enterprise application registrations for single sign-on (SSO).

resources.title: Manage users and groups in Azure Active Directory

children.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
children.description: Implement granular access control using Azure RBAC to define permissions, and enforce strong authentication using Azure AD Multi-Factor Authentication.

resources.title: What is Azure role-based access control (Azure RBAC)?

children.name: Hybrid Identity with Azure AD Connect
children.description: Implement and manage hybrid identity solutions to synchronize on-premises Active Directory with Azure AD using Azure AD Connect, enabling seamless user experiences.

resources.title: Choose the right authentication method for your Azure AD hybrid identity solution

children.name: Azure AD Conditional Access
children.description: Configure Conditional Access policies to enforce specific conditions for accessing resources, enhancing security and compliance based on user, device, location, and application context.

children.name: Managed Identities for Azure Resources
children.description: Learn to use Managed Identities to provide Azure services with an automatically managed identity in Azure AD, eliminating the need to manage credentials.

resources.title: What are managed identities for Azure resources?
Configure managed identities for Azure resources

children.name: Azure Key Vault for Secrets Management
children.description: Securely store and manage cryptographic keys, certificates, and secrets using Azure Key Vault, integrating it with applications and other Azure services.

resources.title: Integrate Key Vault with Azure services

children.name: Azure AD Identity Protection & Governance
children.description: Utilize Azure AD Identity Protection to detect and remediate identity-based risks, and explore Identity Governance features like Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Access Reviews.

resources.title: What is Azure AD Privileged Identity Management?

tree.name: Azure Networking Services
tree.description: Design, implement, and manage secure and scalable network architectures within Azure, connecting resources and ensuring reliable communication across hybrid environments.

children.name: Virtual Networks (VNets) & Subnets
children.description: Create and configure virtual networks, subnets, and IP addressing schemes for isolated and connected resources, understanding CIDR notation and network segmentation.

resources.title: Design an IP addressing plan for your Azure deployment

children.name: Azure Network Security (NSG, ASG, Azure Firewall)
children.description: Implement network-level security using Network Security Groups (NSGs) for granular traffic control, Application Security Groups (ASGs) for simplified rule management, and Azure Firewall for centralized network protection.

resources.title: Azure Networking Tutorial | Virtual Networks, NSG, DNS, Load Balancer, VPN

children.name: Load Balancing & Traffic Management (LB, AGW, AFD, TM)
children.description: Distribute network traffic and ensure high availability and performance using Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway (with WAF capabilities), Azure Front Door, and Traffic Manager.

children.name: Hybrid Network Connectivity (VPN Gateway & ExpressRoute)
children.description: Establish secure and reliable connections between on-premises networks and Azure virtual networks using Azure VPN Gateway (Site-to-Site, Point-to-Site) and Azure ExpressRoute for high-bandwidth, low-latency hybrid cloud scenarios.

children.name: Azure DNS & Content Delivery Network (CDN)
children.description: Manage domain names and DNS resolution with Azure DNS for public and private zones and accelerate content delivery to users globally with Azure CDN.

children.name: VNet Peering & Custom Routing (UDRs)
children.description: Configure VNet peering to connect virtual networks within Azure and implement User-Defined Routes (UDRs) to control network traffic flow and integrate Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs).

resources.title: Route virtual network traffic with a user-defined route
Azure Custom Routing (UDR) in Azure Virtual Network | Learn Networking in Azure

children.name: Azure Private Link & Service Endpoints
children.description: Securely connect to Azure platform services (PaaS) using private endpoints with Azure Private Link, and secure your service endpoints for direct connectivity from virtual networks.

resources.title: Azure Private Link vs Service Endpoints Explained in Detail
Azure Private Link and Private Endpoint Explained

children.name: Azure DDoS Protection
children.description: Protect your Azure applications and resources from distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks with Azure DDoS Protection Standard.

tree.name: Azure Compute Services
tree.description: Deploy and manage various compute resources, from virtual machines and containers to serverless functions, to host your applications and microservices efficiently.

children.name: Azure Virtual Machines (VMs) & VM Scale Sets
children.description: Provision and manage Windows/Linux virtual machines, configure availability options (Availability Sets, Availability Zones), and scale out applications automatically using VM Scale Sets.

resources.title: What are Azure virtual machine scale sets?
Availability options for Azure Virtual Machines

children.name: Azure App Service (Web Apps, API Apps)
children.description: Deploy, configure, and scale web applications, REST APIs, and mobile backends with Azure App Service, including deployment slots, custom domains, and integration with other services.

resources.title: Create a web app in Azure App Service

children.name: Azure Functions & Logic Apps (Serverless Compute)
children.description: Develop event-driven serverless applications with Azure Functions for executing code on demand, and build automated workflows with Azure Logic Apps for integration across services and systems.

children.name: Azure Containers Fundamentals (ACI & Container Apps)
children.description: Understand containerization concepts and deploy isolated, burstable container workloads with Azure Container Instances (ACI) and learn to build and deploy modern apps and microservices with Azure Container Apps.

resources.title: Azure Container Apps - Simply Explained (Microservices, KEDA, Dapr)

children.name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Fundamentals
children.description: Get started with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS): deploy, manage, and scale containerized applications using Kubernetes orchestration, including basic networking, storage integration, and cluster management.

resources.title: Build and run containerized applications with Azure Kubernetes Service

tree.name: Azure Storage & Data Services
tree.description: Understand and implement various data storage solutions and database offerings in Azure, catering to different data types, access patterns, and scalability requirements.

resources.title: Explore relational data offerings in Azure

children.name: Azure Storage Accounts (Blob, File, Table, Queue)
children.description: Utilize Azure Storage Accounts for various data storage needs: Blobs for unstructured data, Files for shared storage, Tables for NoSQL, and Queues for messaging, including access tiers, security, and data redundancy options.

children.name: Azure Managed Disks & Snapshots
children.description: Understand and manage persistent block storage for Azure Virtual Machines with Managed Disks (OS and Data disks), including disk types (Standard HDD, SSD, Premium SSD, Ultra Disk), snapshots, and encryption.

children.name: Azure Relational Databases (SQL DB, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
children.description: Deploy and manage fully managed relational databases compatible with SQL Server (Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance) and popular open-source databases (Azure Database for PostgreSQL, MySQL).

resources.title: What is Azure Database for PostgreSQL?
What is Azure Database for MySQL?

children.name: Azure NoSQL Databases & Caching (Cosmos DB, Redis Cache)
children.description: Explore Azure Cosmos DB, Microsoft's globally distributed, multi-model NoSQL database service for high-performance applications, and Azure Cache for Redis for high-throughput, low-latency data caching.

resources.title: What is Azure Cache for Redis?

children.name: Azure File Sync & Azure NetApp Files
children.description: Implement Azure File Sync to centralize your organization's file shares in Azure Storage while maintaining the flexibility, performance, and compatibility of an on-premises file server. Explore Azure NetApp Files for high-performance, enterprise-grade file storage.

resources.title: How to set up Azure File Sync - Step-by-Step Tutorial

children.name: Azure Data Migration Services
children.description: Understand strategies and tools for migrating databases and data to Azure, including Azure Migrate, Azure Data Box, and Azure Database Migration Service for various scenarios.

resources.title: What is Azure Database Migration Service?

tree.name: Azure Monitoring & Cost Management
tree.description: Implement robust monitoring, gain insights into resource performance and health, and manage cloud spend for efficient and optimized Azure environments.

resources.title: Predict and optimize costs with Azure Cost Management and Billing

children.name: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics & Application Insights
children.description: Collect, analyze, and act on telemetry data from your Azure and on-premises environments using Azure Monitor, query logs with KQL in Log Analytics workspaces, and monitor application performance and availability with Application Insights.

children.name: Azure Alerts, Action Groups & Dashboards
children.description: Configure alerts based on metrics, logs, and activity events, automate responses with action groups (notifications, automation), and visualize monitoring data using custom Azure dashboards.

resources.title: Create, view, and manage metric alerts in Azure Monitor
Create and manage action groups in the Azure portal

children.name: Azure Resource Health & Service Health
children.description: Monitor the health of your individual Azure resources with Azure Resource Health and stay informed about Azure service outages, planned maintenance, and health advisories with Azure Service Health.

children.name: Azure Cost Management & Billing
children.description: Monitor, analyze, and optimize your cloud spend with Azure Cost Management and Billing tools, implementing budgets, cost alerts, and recommendations for financial governance.

resources.title: Optimize your cloud investment with Azure Cost Management

tree.name: Azure Governance & Compliance
tree.description: Implement policies, manage resource hierarchies, and ensure compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements across your Azure estate.

children.name: Azure Management Groups & Subscriptions
children.description: Organize your Azure resources into management groups and subscriptions for scalable governance, access management, and cost reporting, creating a logical hierarchy.

resources.title: Organize your resources with Azure management groups

children.name: Azure Policy & Azure Blueprints
children.description: Enforce organizational standards, assess compliance, and automate policy enforcement at scale using Azure Policy. Compose governed subscriptions with Azure Blueprints for repeatable deployments of compliant environments.

children.name: Azure Resource Tags & Locks
children.description: Implement resource tagging for organization, cost management, and automation. Apply resource locks to prevent accidental deletion or modification of critical Azure resources, enhancing operational safety.

resources.title: Use tags to organize your Azure resources and management hierarchy
Lock resources to prevent unexpected changes

children.name: Azure Compliance & Auditing
children.description: Understand Azure's compliance offerings, audit logs (Azure Activity Logs, Diagnostic Logs), and security baselines to meet regulatory requirements and maintain a secure cloud posture through continuous monitoring and reporting.

resources.title: Introduction to Azure security, privacy, and compliance

tree.name: Azure Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
tree.description: Automate routine cloud management tasks and provision Azure resources consistently and repeatably using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and principles.

resources.title: Automate Azure tasks by using runbooks and Azure Automation
Automate your deployments with Azure Resource Manager templates

children.name: Azure Automation (Runbooks, State Configuration)
children.description: Automate routine cloud management tasks, orchestrate operational processes with runbooks (PowerShell, Python), and manage configuration using Azure Automation State Configuration (DSC).

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with ARM/Bicep/Terraform
children.description: Automate the provisioning and deployment of Azure resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) Templates, Bicep for declarative Azure deployments, and HashiCorp Terraform for multi-cloud IaC.

resources.title: Use Terraform to create Azure infrastructure

children.name: Configuration Management & Desired State Configuration (DSC)
children.description: Learn to maintain server configurations consistently across hybrid environments using Desired State Configuration (DSC) and integrate with Azure Automation State Configuration for continuous compliance.

tree.name: Azure DevOps & CI/CD
tree.description: Integrate DevOps practices and implement Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software development and infrastructure deployment workflows on Azure.

resources.title: Create a CI/CD pipeline with Azure DevOps

children.name: Introduction to Azure DevOps Services
children.description: Understand the core components of Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans, Artifacts) and their role in the modern software delivery lifecycle and cloud operations.

children.name: Git & Version Control for Azure Projects
children.description: Master Git for source code management, branching strategies (e.g., GitFlow, GitHub Flow), and integrating with Azure Repos or GitHub for collaborative development and IaC management.

resources.title: Share your code with Git in Azure Repos

children.name: Building & Managing CI/CD Pipelines (Azure Pipelines)
children.description: Design and implement continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD) pipelines to automate application builds, tests, and deployments to Azure resources, including multi-stage YAML pipelines and release gates.

children.name: Release Management & Deployment Strategies
children.description: Explore advanced deployment strategies like blue-green deployments, canary releases, feature flags, and progressive rollouts for safe, reliable, and progressive software delivery in Azure.

children.name: Artifact Management & Container Registries
children.description: Manage package feeds using Azure Artifacts for various package types (NuGet, npm, Maven, Python) and container images with Azure Container Registry (ACR) for efficient storage and distribution of build artifacts and Docker images.

resources.title: Introduction to private Docker container registries in Azure

tree.name: Advanced Operations & Solution Design
tree.description: Explore advanced Azure services, security operations, design patterns, and best practices for building highly available, resilient, and optimized solutions.

children.name: High Availability & Disaster Recovery Strategies
children.description: Design and implement highly available and disaster-resilient solutions using Azure features like Availability Sets, Availability Zones, cross-region replication, and Azure Site Recovery services for business continuity.

children.name: Azure Backup & Recovery Services
children.description: Implement robust data protection strategies using Azure Backup for various workloads (VMs, databases, files) and manage recovery services vaults for centralized backup and restore operations.

resources.title: Implement Azure Backup Service | Step By Step Tutorial
Azure Backup Service Tutorial For Beginners | Azure Backup And Recovery Manager Tutorial

children.name: Hybrid & Multi-cloud Management (Azure Arc, Stack HCI)
children.description: Connect and manage on-premises and multi-cloud environments with Azure services using Azure Arc, extending Azure management to any infrastructure, and explore hybrid infrastructure solutions with Azure Stack HCI.

children.name: Advanced Data Platform Operations
children.description: Understand the operational aspects of key Azure services for data platforms, including deploying and managing Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics workspaces, Azure Data Factory pipelines, and related data services.

resources.title: Introduction to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
Azure Synapse Analytics Full Course for Beginners - Learn Analytics with Azure Synapse

children.name: Cloud Migration Strategies & Tools
children.description: Understand different cloud migration strategies (rehost, refactor, re-architect, rebuild, replace) and leverage Azure tools like Azure Migrate to plan and execute comprehensive migrations to Azure.

children.name: Azure Messaging & Event Services
children.description: Implement robust messaging solutions with Azure Service Bus for enterprise messaging, Azure Event Hubs for big data streaming and real-time analytics, and Azure Event Grid for reactive, event-driven architectures.

children.name: Advanced Network Security & Threat Protection
children.description: Implement advanced network security features like Azure Web Application Firewall (WAF) for web application protection, Network Virtual Appliances (NVAs) for advanced routing and security, and understand DDoS protection strategies.

resources.title: What is Azure Web Application Firewall?

children.name: Azure Defender for Cloud & Microsoft Sentinel
children.description: Utilize Microsoft Defender for Cloud to strengthen your security posture, protect hybrid workloads, and identify threats across your environment. Integrate with Microsoft Sentinel for cloud-native Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR).

resources.title: What is Microsoft Defender for Cloud?
Microsoft Defender For Cloud (Azure Security Center) Tutorial for Beginners

children.name: Azure Well-Architected Framework & Best Practices
children.description: Learn to design, build, and operate secure, high-performing, resilient, and cost-effective applications in the cloud by applying the five pillars of the Azure Well-Architected Framework (Cost Optimization, Operational Excellence, Performance Efficiency, Reliability, Security).

tree.name: Project & Career Readiness
tree.description: Consolidate your learning through a hands-on capstone project and prepare for real-world job applications, technical interviews, and relevant industry certifications.

resources.title: AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator Certification Prep Guide

children.name: Azure Cloud Engineer Capstone Project
children.description: Design, implement, deploy, and monitor a multi-service Azure solution, documenting architectural decisions, infrastructure as code, and operational procedures for a realistic scenario, demonstrating end-to-end cloud engineering skills.

children.name: Technical Documentation & Runbook Creation
children.description: Learn best practices for creating clear, comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, post-mortems, and troubleshooting guides, crucial for any cloud professional.

resources.title: Technical Writing 101 - A FREE Full Course on How to Write Technical Documentation

children.name: Advanced Troubleshooting & Performance Tuning
children.description: Develop skills in identifying, diagnosing, and resolving complex issues in Azure environments, along with techniques for optimizing performance, resilience, and cost of solutions through monitoring and analysis.

resources.title: Azure Monitor & Log Analytics Deep Dive (Kusto Query Language)
Azure Cost Management and Optimization Walkthrough

children.name: Certification & Interview Preparation
children.description: Prepare for technical interviews with common Azure Cloud Engineer questions, mock interviews, and understand the path to relevant industry certifications like AZ-104 (Azure Administrator Associate) and AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

resources.title: Exam AZ-305: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions
AZ-104 Azure Administrator Associate Full Course
